actuator.provenance: Effort limits from Universal Robots' ur7e joint_limits.yaml (src/python/asset_pipeline/ur7e_cell/official); published model limits, not measured motor curves. Armature 0.1 kg m2 on every joint is the nominal value of the station's UR model (phys_model/builder/robot_builder.py, from MuJoCo Menagerie's UR5e), not a measured rotor inertia. Joint PD gains are the FANUC profile's nominal values; the gantry scene commands torque through its Cartesian controller and does not use them. Ideal model gravity feedforward before effort saturation.

jaw.provenance: Robotiq Hand-E: 25 mm travel per finger, fingers coupled by one motor (mimic constraint in the model). Force limit 20 N per finger is the gripper's lowest setting (range 20 to 185 N); 0.1 m/s is inside its 0.02 to 0.15 m/s range. PD gains, the 20 ms target filter and the 0.05 kg armature are the nominal servo of the scene, not measured on a Hand-E

hande_body.provenance: Robotiq Hand-E coupler 0.119 kg + body 0.864 kg (product sheet); centre of mass at mid height and the inertia of a uniform 75 mm x 110 mm cylinder are nominal, not measured

hande_finger_right.provenance: Hand-E fingertip holder, flat silicone fingertip and four M3 screws, calculated from the box dimensions of Robotiq's drawings with aluminium 2700 kg/m3, silicone 1150 kg/m3 and 0.6 g per screw; the rack is part of the gripper body; not measured

hande_finger_left.provenance: Hand-E fingertip holder, flat silicone fingertip and four M3 screws, calculated from the box dimensions of Robotiq's drawings with aluminium 2700 kg/m3, silicone 1150 kg/m3 and 0.6 g per screw; the rack is part of the gripper body; not measured

wrist_camera.provenance: nominal camera and mount lump; calibrated camera transform, unmeasured inertia

contact.provenance: nominal Newton native MuJoCo contact parameters; explicit condim 6 activates declared torsional and rolling friction; no restitution or PhysX combine-mode equivalence

dice.provenance: nominal ABS-density 20 mm cube; inertia derived from authored CAD bounds

block_b.provenance: nominal support block mass; inertia derived from authored CAD bounds

solver.provenance: declared numerical settings; native MuJoCo contacts, implicitfast, Newton solver; elliptic cone and friction impedance ratio 10 address regularized soft-contact creep per official MuJoCo modeling documentation (https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/blob/main/doc/modeling.rst); controlled native episode smoke_04_elliptic10 passed strict hold gates with unchanged physical friction coefficients, actuator gains, and guard thresholds; these are numerical settings, not fitted material measurements
